data.rationale: The proposal gets the IMDb lookup, the Rotten Tomatoes lookup and the email compose steps in the right order, with the right subject and body templates, but it gets the last step backwards: it says to send the email, while the true workflow says not to click Send and to click Discard. It also splits {friend} into two separate parameters for the email and the name, and may add an extra '%' after the Tomatometer score. Those two issues are minor, but an automation built from this spec would send an email the user never sent.
